[1 media attachment] yes #github, I scrolled all the way down  to the bottom of the page on my own! I'm a big boy now!

FFS!... I just cannot stand that heinous UX trend of constantly "congratulating" the user for strictly no fucking reason whatsoever.

Not every single user experience in software has to be as nauseating as talking to an obsequious chatbot, for crying out loud!
